message: Final small caller-boundary check: Expressions.expression() recurses within one string without incrementing the value() step budget, and the CLI final exception list currently omits RecursionError (shared recursive directory scan can raise it too). Ensure excessive expression/scan nesting yields a typed BLOCKED envelope, not an uncaught traceback. A bounded parser depth and/or explicit sanitized RecursionError mapping plus a focused negative test is sufficient; no broader feature work. Preserve the closed expression policy.
